event_sleeping_guard.why: 球球冷灰色、深灰條紋；主圖已畫成躡腳走過（還做噓的手勢），跟 r1「悄悄通過」幾乎同構圖，先畫出了結果。主文是球球剛到、大橘貓靠門打盹、錢袋鼓鼓、身旁一條能側身通過的窄路：主圖應該是球球在旁觀察、打量守衛和那條窄路。
event_sleeping_guard.scene: SETTING on a small patch of grey cobblestone floor: a short grey stone-block wall with a tall ARCHED DARK-WOOD DOOR set into its right part (iron hinge straps, a round iron ring handle). A HUGE, fat ORANGE TABBY GUARD CAT (orange fur with darker orange stripes, a big cream belly, pink paw pads, exactly like the orange guard cat in reference image 3) sits on the floor FAST ASLEEP, slumped with his back against the wall just LEFT of the door, legs stretched out in front of him, eyes shut, mouth open in a snore. Around his big belly: a brown leather belt with a brass buckle, a ring of brass keys hanging from it, and a fat, BULGING brown leather MONEY POUCH tied at his right hip (the hip nearest the door). Between the guard's right side and the door there is a NARROW PATH: three flat stepping stones in a row leading to the door, only wide enough for a small cat to slip past sideways; the corner there, where the wall meets the door frame, lies in a dark shadow. Qiuqiu has only just arrived and has NOT moved past yet: he stands still on the LEFT side of the floor patch, a clear distance away from the guard's feet, in a low cautious crouch, knees bent, body turned toward the guard. His right paw is raised to his chin in a thinking pose - fingers curled, NO raised or pointing finger, NOT touching his lips. His left paw rests on his left knee. His eyes are narrowed and sharp, sizing up the bulging money pouch and the narrow stepping-stone path beside the guard; a small sly, calculating look. He is NOT tiptoeing, NOT walking, NOT reaching. QIUQIU'S FUR is the warm, slightly pinkish PALE CREAM of reference image 1 with soft grey-brown stripes - NOT cool grey, NOT grey-and-white, no dark charcoal stripes.

event_sleeping_guard_r1.scene: SETTING: EXACTLY the same place as reference image 3 (the main picture of this same event): the same grey cobblestone floor patch, the same grey stone-block wall with the tall arched dark-wood door on the right, the SAME huge fat orange tabby guard cat still FAST ASLEEP slumped against the wall left of the door (eyes shut, mouth open, snoring), with the same belt, brass keys and the bulging brown money pouch still tied at his hip, and the same narrow path of three flat stepping stones between the guard's side and the door. Now Qiuqiu is walking along that narrow stepping-stone path, slipping sideways past the sleeping guard toward the door: his body turned sideways, back close to the guard's side but not touching him, one foot lightly set down on a stepping stone and the other foot lifted mid-step, both paws held low and relaxed at his sides for balance. His face is CALM and relaxed: eyes softly half-closed, mouth gently closed, a faint easy smile, breathing slowly - one small soft white breath curl near his nose. He is NOT holding his breath (no puffed cheeks, no sweat). He does NOT touch the guard or the money pouch. event_moving_rat.why: 球球冷灰色、深灰條紋；老鼠笑嘻嘻地伸手快碰到球球，像在推銷或扒竊。文字是老鼠坐在階梯上邊數家當邊嘆氣、好聲好氣提議交換，只是指著球球的行囊（噹噹版前一輪已改成這個語氣）。
event_moving_rat.scene: SETTING: a few wide grey stone steps on a small patch of stone floor. The SAME big brown RAT as in reference image 3 (brown fur, cream belly, big round pink ears, a long pink tail, and on his back the same huge overstuffed patched burlap bundle tied with rope, with a frying pan, a rolled green mat and a yellow gourd strapped to it) SITS on one of the stone steps. Laid out in a row on the step beside him are some of his belongings: a small rolled scroll, a little cloth sack and a few gold coins. He touches the coins with one paw, counting them, and SIGHS: a tired, troubled face, eyebrows tilted up, droopy half-closed eyes, a small white sigh puff near his mouth - friendly and a little worn out, NO grin, NO scheming look. His other paw is held out OPEN, palm up, politely gesturing toward the small brown travel pouch tied at Qiuqiu's black sash - just gesturing from where he sits; his paw stays far away from the pouch, NOT reaching for it and NOT touching it. Qiuqiu stands on the floor a short distance away (a clear gap between them), facing the rat, listening with a thoughtful, slightly hesitant face, his right paw at his chin (fingers curled, no raised finger), his left paw resting on the small brown travel pouch at his hip. QIUQIU'S FUR is the warm, slightly pinkish PALE CREAM of reference image 1 with soft grey-brown stripes - NOT cool grey, NOT grey-and-white.

event_heavy_door_r0.scene: SETTING: the SAME massive grey stone door as in reference image 3 (grey stone slab with iron studs and a round iron ring handle, in a thick frame of big grey stone blocks, on a small patch of grey stone floor). The door has now been SHOVED WIDE OPEN, swung inward, so the viewer sees into the small dim room behind it, lit with warm golden light. Just inside the doorway, on the room's floor, sits the small woven basket full of dried fish. Further in, stands the wooden treasure chest bound with iron bands, its front carved with a fierce MONSTER-FACE emblem (as in reference image 3); its lid is now OPEN. Qiuqiu has walked in and kneels beside the open chest INSIDE the room, framed by the open doorway. His RIGHT paw lifts a glowing relic out of the chest - a round golden amulet with a red gem, firmly held in his closed paw. His shoulder that faces the viewer is scraped from shoving the door: on the TOP OUTER ROUND OF THAT SHOULDER, where the arm joins the body (NOT on his chest, NOT on his collar), the navy sleeve is torn open and a small patch of fur is rubbed off, showing a small sore pink spot. He winces, enduring the pain: both eyes squeezed shut the same way, teeth gritted, a sweat drop. His left paw rests on the rim of the chest. QIUQIU'S FUR is the warm, slightly pinkish PALE CREAM of reference image 1 with soft grey-brown stripes - NOT cool grey, NOT grey-and-white.

event_moon_window.why: 球球偏灰；主圖畫成坐在窗台望月，跟 r1「坐著看月亮」幾乎同構圖，碗底蜷睡小貓也看不到。主文是月光落在窗台的空碗裡、碗底刻著蜷睡小貓、旁邊還能坐一隻貓，球球問「有人在這裡餵貓喵？」：主圖應該是球球湊過去看碗。
event_moon_window.scene: SETTING: the SAME big ROUND WINDOW as in reference image 3 - a thick dark-wood frame showing a deep navy night sky with a big pale-yellow full moon - and at its base the same curved wooden window ledge standing on the floor. A soft pale beam of moonlight shines in through the window and falls onto a small EMPTY grey ceramic bowl sitting on the ledge toward its RIGHT end. The bowl is seen from a little above so we can look inside it: on its bottom is a simple carved line drawing of a small curled-up SLEEPING KITTEN (a picture, no writing). The bowl is empty - no food, no glowing cat. The LEFT part of the ledge next to the bowl is empty - room for one cat to sit. Qiuqiu has just come upon it and has NOT sat down: he stands on the floor at the left, leaning forward over the ledge, both front paws resting on the ledge edge, his head bent DOWN to peer into the bowl with a curious, puzzled face - head tilted, ears perked, big round eyes, mouth slightly open as if asking a question. He looks at the bowl, not at the moon, and does not touch the bowl. QIUQIU'S FUR is the warm, slightly pinkish PALE CREAM of reference image 1 with soft grey-brown stripes - NOT cool grey, NOT grey-and-white.

Qiuqiu CROUCHES low on his heels at the SIDE of the box, a short distance away from the wall, leaning his head sideways to peer at the box and the note with narrowed, suspicious eyes and one eyebrow raised, mouth a small doubtful line. Both of his paws stay pulled in close to his own body: his left paw rests on his knee and his right paw is raised to his chin in thought (fingers curled, no raised or pointing finger). He does NOT reach out - no arm is stretched toward the box, and there is a clear empty gap between his paws and the box.
